description: The fields of data that architecture §3.8.1 fixes for every event, with context_ref, bodies and operator_proof (implementation §10.1). Every event's data is validated against it; no topic schema repeats these fields.

topic.description: The topic on which the task is announced, and only that; the topic a request is about travels in target_topic (architecture §3.7.7).

task_embedding.description: The task's embedding: base64 over little-endian float32 (implementation §1.2.1). Only in task.announced (architecture §3.7.4).

model_id.description: The vector space the task_embedding was generated under (architecture §3.7.3).

workspace.description: Project or repository identifier, chosen by whoever opens the trace and inherited unchanged down the trace (architecture §3.5.1, §2.4).

origin_audience.description: The audience of the channel that opened the trace, inherited like workspace (architecture §3.5.3).

context_ref.description: The Claim-Check reference to the Context Store (architecture §3.4), with the field names of the NRI's ContextRef (implementation §3).

bodies.description: The references to the bodies of an ingress message, stamped by the channel's Integration Sidecar (architecture §3.16.7, implementation §3, Ingress).

ref.description: Where the body is in the Context Store.

context.description: The body came as context of the conversation, not of the request (architecture §3.16.7).

current_attempts.description: How many times the subtask was attempted, stamped by the requester's Integration Sidecar (architecture §3.3).

previous_attempt.description: The TaskID of the attempt a task.announced reopens (architecture §3.3).

final_round.description: Marks the attempt that opens the final round of a human query (architecture §3.5.2).

declared_similarity.description: In task.proposed, optional: a ceiling on the similarity the Task Broker recomputes (architecture §3.7.5).

similarity.description: The similarity the Task Broker recomputed: in task.assigned the winner's, in task.rejected that of the candidate that lost (architecture §3.8.1, §3.7.5).

requester_identity.description: The platform identity of the node that opened the task, to which its terminal event is addressed; declared in each announcement and copied into the task.assigned (architecture §3.6.1).

scope_token.description: The Context Store scope token, only in task.assigned (architecture §3.14.3), in compact JWS (implementation §9).

failure_code.description: In the task.failed whose cause the architecture fixes (architecture §3.3). Known values: unanswered, undelivered, stale_vector_space, redundant_topic, not_derivable, logic_container_lost, channel_retired, proof_invalid, base_version_stale, request_invalid, artifact_vetoed, runtime_interface_unsupported, egress_slot_unbound, ingress_slot_unbound, blueprint_muted, capacity_exhausted, embedding_unavailable, admission_failed, acquisition_denied, no_forge (implementation §10.1). A requester that does not know the value reads the failure_reason.

suggested_topic.description: Optional in task.failed, when the reason is redundancy with a covered topic (architecture §3.13.2).

metrics.description: Mandatory in every task.completed and task.failed (architecture §3.10).

operator_proof.description: The operator's proof of a signed act, in compact JWS (architecture §3.14.2, implementation §9).
